# Data Architecture & Dictionary — AstroGuide AI

This directory houses the synthetic relational data generated for the customer churn and retention analytics project.

## Directory Structure

* `raw/`: Unmodified synthetic CSV tables generated by `src/generate_data.py`.
* `processed/`: Transformed, cleaned, and star-schema analytical tables ready for SQL ingestion and Power BI modeling.

---

## 📅 Timeline & Leakage-Free Design Protocol

To ensure 100% data leakage prevention during modeling, the dataset adheres to a strict dual-window calendar protocol:

* **Acquisition Window:** `2025-01-01` to `2025-07-31` (7 months of user signups).
* **Observation Cutoff Date ($t_0$):** `2025-08-31`. All feature engineering must strictly use events and transactions occurring on or before this date. Every user in the cohort has at least 31 days of tenure prior to $t_0$.
* **Outcome / Evaluation Window:** `2025-09-01` to `2025-09-30` (30 calendar days).
* **Churn Definition:** A user is classified as **Churned (`churn_label = 1`)** if they record **zero sessions** during the 30-day outcome window. Users recording $\ge 1$ session are classified as **Retained (`churn_label = 0`)**.

---

## 🗄️ Relational Schema & Data Dictionary

### 1. `users.csv` (10,000 rows)
Primary entity table capturing customer acquisition and profile details.

| Field | Type | Description | Allowed Values / Constraints |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `user_id` | String | Unique synthetic customer identifier (**Primary Key**) | `USR_000001` - `USR_010000` |
| `signup_date` | Date | Date user registered on AstroGuide AI | `2025-01-01` to `2025-07-31` |
| `acquisition_channel` | String | Marketing channel where user converted | `Organic Search`, `Instagram Ads`, `TikTok Ads`, `Google Ads`, `Referral` |
| `country` | String | Geographic country code | `US`, `UK`, `CA`, `AU`, `DE`, `IN` |
| `age_group` | String | User demographic age bucket | `18-24`, `25-34`, `35-44`, `45-54`, `55+` |
| `device_type` | String | Mobile / client operating system | `iOS`, `Android`, `Web` |
| `marketing_campaign` | String | Specific advertising campaign tag | E.g., `IG_Summer_Vibes`, `TT_BirthChart_Viral` |
| `onboarding_completed` | Boolean | Whether user completed initial birth-chart setup | `True`, `False` |
| `zodiac_sign` | String | Tropical zodiac sign of the user | Aries through Pisces (12 signs) |
| `subscription_plan` | String | Initial plan selected upon registration | `Free`, `Weekly_Premium`, `Monthly_Premium`, `Annual_Premium` |

### 2. `subscriptions.csv` (4,740 rows)
Lifecycle history for users who enrolled in premium subscription tiers.

| Field | Type | Description | Constraints |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `subscription_id` | String | Unique subscription record (**Primary Key**) | `SUB_000001` - `SUB_004740` |
| `user_id` | String | User foreign key (**FK -> users.user_id**) | Valid user ID |
| `plan_name` | String | Premium subscription tier | `Weekly_Premium`, `Monthly_Premium`, `Annual_Premium` |
| `subscription_start_date`| Date | Start date of subscription | $\ge$ user's `signup_date` |
| `subscription_end_date` | Date | Projected or actual expiration date | $\ge$ `subscription_start_date` |
| `billing_interval` | String | Frequency of automated renewal billing | `Weekly`, `Monthly`, `Annual` |
| `subscription_status` | String | Current status at cutoff date | `Active`, `Cancelled` |
| `renewal_count` | Integer | Number of successful recurring renewals | $\ge 0$ |
| `cancellation_date` | Date | Date user requested cancellation (if cancelled) | `YYYY-MM-DD` or `null` |
| `cancellation_reason` | String | Survey reason provided upon cancellation | E.g., `Too Expensive`, `Not Enough Value`, `None` |

### 3. `transactions.csv` (27,562 rows)
Financial ledger recording recurring subscription billings and one-off purchases.

| Field | Type | Description | Constraints |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `transaction_id` | String | Unique transaction ledger entry (**Primary Key**) | `TXN_0000001`+ |
| `user_id` | String | User foreign key (**FK -> users.user_id**) | Valid user ID |
| `transaction_date` | Date | Date charge was attempted | `2025-01-01` to `2025-08-31` |
| `product_type` | String | Item purchased | `Subscription_Initial`, `Subscription_Renewal`, `Tarot_Reading_OneOff`, `Compatibility_Full_Report`, `Yearly_Transit_Forecast` |
| `amount` | Float | Transaction dollar value | Positive float ($3.99 to $59.99) |
| `currency` | String | Currency code | `USD` |
| `payment_status` | String | Payment gateway settlement status | `Success`, `Failed`, `Refunded` |
| `refund_flag` | Boolean | Flag indicating transaction was reversed | `True`, `False` |

### 4. `user_activity.csv` (1,345,770 rows)
Granular behavioral telemetry event log.

| Field | Type | Description | Constraints |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `event_id` | String | Unique telemetry event record (**Primary Key**) | `EVT_00000001`+ |
| `user_id` | String | User foreign key (**FK -> users.user_id**) | Valid user ID |
| `event_timestamp` | Timestamp | Timestamp of user interaction | `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` |
| `event_date` | Date | Calendar date of event | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `event_type` | String | Type of event | `app_open`, `daily_horoscope_view`, `ai_chat_started`, `compatibility_report_viewed`, `tarot_reading_completed`, `paywall_viewed`, `notification_opened` |
| `feature_name` | String | Functional module in application | `App`, `Horoscope`, `AI_Chat`, `Compatibility`, `Tarot`, `Paywall`, `Notification` |
| `session_duration_seconds` | Integer | Duration of interaction in seconds | Strictly $> 0$ |
| `notification_opened` | Boolean | Interaction triggered via push notification | `True`, `False` |
| `session_number` | Integer | Cumulative sequential session count for user | $\ge 1$ |

### 5. `churn_labels.csv` (10,000 rows)
Target variable table for predictive retention modeling.

| Field | Type | Description | Constraints |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `user_id` | String | User identifier (**Primary Key & FK**) | Matches all users in cohort |
| `observation_cutoff_date`| Date | Cutoff boundary date | `2025-08-31` |
| `outcome_window_days` | Integer | Evaluation window duration | `30` |
| `outcome_sessions_count` | Integer | Sessions logged between Sept 1 and Sept 30 | $\ge 0$ |
| `churn_label` | Integer | Ground truth churn flag: `1` = Churned, `0` = Retained | Binary (`0` or `1`) |
